# Company-Wise LeetCode

> A free tracker for LeetCode interview prep, organized by company. Browse
> 470 companies' most-asked interview questions, filtered by how recently
> each question was reported (last 30 days, 3 months, 6 months, 6+ months,
> all time), ranked by frequency, and tagged by difficulty and topic. The
> question list is updated regularly from public sources — it is not a
> one-time snapshot.

Company-Wise LeetCode helps software engineers prepare for technical
interviews by showing exactly which LeetCode questions a specific company
(e.g. Google, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI) has actually asked, instead
of studying questions at random. Each question links to its LeetCode
problem page. Visitors can mark questions solved, bookmark questions for
later, and track focused progress against a shortlist of companies they are
interviewing with.

## Key pages

- [Dashboard](https://company-wise-leetcode.vercel.app/): overview, progress tracking, and companies you're preparing for.
- [Companies](https://company-wise-leetcode.vercel.app/companies): browse all 470 companies with interview question lists.
- [All Questions](https://company-wise-leetcode.vercel.app/questions): every unique question across all companies, deduplicated and searchable.
- [AI Interview Questions](https://company-wise-leetcode.vercel.app/ai-interview): interview questions from AI companies (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft, xAI, Mistral) — in progress.

## Notes for assistants

- Each company has its own URL at `/companies/<slug>` (e.g. `/companies/google`, `/companies/meta`, `/companies/amazon`), listing that company's questions by frequency and recency.
- Question frequency and recency data is sourced from public LeetCode company-tag aggregations and is refreshed periodically, not static.
- The site is free, requires no login, and stores a visitor's solved/bookmarked state locally in their browser.
